config = '''[tool.ruff]
line-length = 100
target-version = "py314"

[tool.ruff.lint]
select = ["E", "F", "I", "UP"]

[tool.ruff.format]
quote-style = "double"
indent-style = "space"
'''

print(config)

try:
    import tomllib
    parsed = tomllib.loads(config)
    assert parsed["tool"]["ruff"]["line-length"] == 100
    assert parsed["tool"]["ruff"]["target-version"] == "py314"
    assert parsed["tool"]["ruff"]["lint"]["select"] == ["E", "F", "I", "UP"]
    assert parsed["tool"]["ruff"]["format"]["quote-style"] == "double"
    assert parsed["tool"]["ruff"]["format"]["indent-style"] == "space"
except ImportError:
    pass
